app.name: Nirapod
app.description: One camera, four protections: diabetes companion, private skin screening, medicine safety and emergency support.

emergency.title: Emergency Support
emergency.intro: If someone may be in danger, call 999 now.
emergency.about999: 999 is Bangladesh's national emergency number. It connects you to police, fire service and ambulance providers.
emergency.cost: Calling 999 is free. Ambulance services may charge a fee.
emergency.locationError: Could not get your location. Please tell the operator where you are.
emergency.linkCopied: Link copied. Paste it in a message.
emergency.nearbyHospitalsHint: Opens a map search. Share your location first for better results.
emergency.checklistTitle: Is any of these happening now?
emergency.checklistHint: Tap every sign you see. Any one of them means: call 999.
emergency.strokeTime: T = Time: note when the signs started and call 999 at once.

chestPain.label: Chest pain or pressure
chestPain.hint: May spread to the arm, jaw or back, or come with sweating.

strokeFace.label: F — Face drooping on one side
strokeFace.hint: Ask them to smile. Is one side of the face drooping?

strokeArm.label: A — Arm or leg weak on one side
strokeArm.hint: Ask them to raise both arms. Does one drift down?

strokeSpeech.label: S — Speech slurred or strange
strokeSpeech.hint: Ask them to repeat a simple sentence.

breathing.label: Severe difficulty breathing
breathing.hint: Cannot speak in full sentences, or lips turning blue.

unconscious.label: Unconscious or not responding
unconscious.hint: Does not wake up or answer when you speak or tap them.

bleeding.label: Heavy bleeding that will not stop
bleeding.hint: Keeps bleeding even with firm pressure.

lowGlucose.label: Blood sugar below {mmol, number} mmol/L ({mgdl, number} mg/dL)
lowGlucose.hint: Or shaking, sweating and confusion in a person with diabetes.

emergency.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# sign selected} other {# signs selected}}

advice.noteTime: Note the time the stroke signs started and tell the doctor.
advice.sweetIfAwake: If the person is awake and can swallow, give something sweet now (juice, sugar or glucose).
advice.nothingByMouth: Do not give food or drink to someone who is unconscious.

emergency.free: This Nirapod feature is always free to use.

diabetes.title: Diabetes Companion
diabetes.intro: Take a photo of your plate. Nirapod will try to recognise the food, estimate the portion and show a green, amber or red signal.
diabetes.trial: Free for 7 weeks from first use.
diabetes.lowSugarBody: Take something sweet now (juice, sugar or glucose). If you feel confused or faint, call 999.
diabetes.disclaimer: This is guidance, not a diagnosis. Never stop, start or change any medicine or insulin dose on your own — ask your doctor or pharmacist.

onboarding.title: Set up the Diabetes Companion
onboarding.intro: A few questions, once. Everything stays on this phone.
onboarding.proofHint: As proof that a doctor diagnosed diabetes. It is kept only on this phone and never uploaded.
onboarding.proofSaved: Prescription photo saved on this phone.
onboarding.proofNeeded: Please add a photo of your prescription.
onboarding.plate: Your usual plate size (across, in cm)
onboarding.plateHint: Measure across your usual plate once. Most dinner plates are about 26 cm.
onboarding.levelNote: Based only on what you entered. It sets how strict the meal signals are. Your doctor knows best.
onboarding.demoData: Use the demo profile with two weeks of sample data

meal.title: Check a meal
meal.hint: Take the photo from above, with the plate filling the photo.
meal.noFood: No food recognised. Please add the foods yourself below.
meal.noModel: To check meals from a photo, download the food model above. You can also add foods by hand below.
meal.privacy: The photo is checked on this phone only and is not saved.
meal.confirmHint: For each food tap less, about right or more. Add anything the app missed.
meal.addMissed: Add a food the app missed
meal.stapleHint: No rice, ruti or puri found. If your plate has some, add it below — the app can miss rice.

signal.green: Green — a good balance for you
signal.amber: Amber — more carbs than your target
signal.red: Red — a lot of carbs for you
signal.stricter: Your 2-hour sugar after {food} meals was often high, so this signal is one step stricter for you.
signal.relaxed: Your 2-hour sugar after {food} meals was usually in range, so this signal is one step softer for you.
signal.estimate: Carbs are estimated from the photo and can be off. This is guidance about the meal only.
signal.saved: Meal saved. We will ask for your 2-hour sugar at {time}.

suggestions.walkAfter: Good choice. A 10–15 minute walk after eating helps your body use the sugar.
suggestions.riceHalf: Next time, try about half the rice and fill the space with vegetables, salad or dal.
suggestions.breadFewer: Try one fewer ruti or puri, and add vegetables or an egg.
suggestions.friedSnack: Fried snacks have a lot of carbs. Keep them small or share one.
suggestions.drinkLessSugar: Try your tea or drink with less sugar, or none.
suggestions.smallerStarch: Take a smaller portion of this, and add salad or vegetables.
suggestions.addVegetables: Add more vegetables or salad, and keep starchy foods to a smaller portion.

glucose.title: Blood sugar

glucose.lowBody: Take something sweet now (juice, sugar or glucose). If the person is confused, very drowsy or unconscious, call 999.

medicines.title: My medicines
medicines.intro: Reminders follow your prescription exactly as written. Nirapod never changes your medicines.
medicines.none: No medicines yet. Add them from a checked prescription (Medicine page) or by hand.
medicines.missedAdvice: Ask your doctor or pharmacist what to do. Do not take an extra dose on your own.

premium.title: Nirapod Premium
premium.trialEnded: Your 7-week free trial of the Diabetes Companion has ended.
premium.intro: Premium is not available yet. Our main Premium idea is the Family Plan.
premium.free: The plate signal, blood sugar readings, low-sugar help and Emergency stay free.

skin.title: Private Skin Screening
skin.intro: Take a clear photo of the skin area in good light. Nirapod will show how likely it may be scabies, with a confidence value.
skin.privacy: Your skin photo is checked on this phone only. It is never uploaded.
skin.disclaimer: This is a screening aid, not a diagnosis. If you are worried, please see a doctor.

medicine.title: Medicine Safety
medicine.intro: Take photos of a prescription, a test report or a medicine pack. Nirapod will explain it in plain language and check expiry, duplicates and interactions.
medicine.packaging: Nirapod only lists suspicious signs on packaging. It cannot verify where a medicine came from.
medicine.disclaimer: Do not stop or change any medicine on your own. Ask your doctor or pharmacist.

results.title: 3. What this means
results.diagnosisNote: Written by your doctor. It comes before any general information below.
results.findingsTitle: Things to check with your doctor or pharmacist
results.noFindings: Our checks found nothing to point out.
results.checksNote: Our checks use a short list only. No warning does not mean the medicines are safe together.
results.profileNote: Allergy and pregnancy checks use the health profile in Settings.
results.sourceAi: Written by AI only from the checked results above; it is not allowed to add medical facts.
results.sourceFallback: Standard explanation (the AI text did not pass our safety check, so it was not shown).
results.disclaimer: This explains your papers; it is not a diagnosis. Do not stop or change any medicine on your own.

findings.duplicateIngredient: {brands} all contain {ingredient}. Taking them together may mean a double dose. Ask your doctor or pharmacist; do not stop on your own.
findings.allergy: {brand} may not suit you: your profile lists an allergy to “{allergy}”. Ask your doctor or pharmacist; do not stop on your own.
findings.pregnancy: {brand} has pregnancy category {category} in the medicine database, which means it may not be suitable in pregnancy. Ask your doctor; do not stop on your own.
findings.notInDatabase: {brand} was not found in the medicine list, so it was not checked.
findings.interaction: {a} and {b}: {text} Ask your doctor or pharmacist; do not stop on your own.

interactions.anticoagulantNsaid: taken together, these may raise the risk of bleeding.
interactions.twoNsaids: two pain medicines of the same kind (NSAIDs) together may raise the risk of stomach and kidney problems.
interactions.clopidogrelPpi: the stomach medicine may make the blood-thinning medicine work less well.
interactions.pde5Nitrate: together these may cause a dangerous drop in blood pressure.
interactions.methotrexateCotrimoxazole: together these may cause serious side effects.
interactions.statinMacrolide: together these may raise the risk of muscle problems.
interactions.potassiumRaising: together these may raise potassium in the blood.
interactions.tramadolSsri: together these may cause a rare but serious reaction (serotonin syndrome).
interactions.quinoloneMinerals: the minerals may make the antibiotic work less well if taken at the same time. Ask your pharmacist about timing.

relations.doesNotFit: {test} is {status, select, high {high} other {low}}, and {brands} usually {effect, select, lowers {lowers} raises {raises} other {affects}} it. This does not fit. Ask your doctor; do not stop on your own.
relations.noLinkedMedicine: {test} is {status, select, high {high} other {low}}, and no medicine on this prescription is commonly linked to it. Ask your doctor; do not stop on your own.

about.title: About Nirapod
about.body: Nirapod is a free, bilingual health helper for people in Bangladesh. It works on your phone, and most features work without internet.
about.guide: Nirapod gives guidance only. It does not diagnose and does not replace a doctor.
about.privacy: Your data stays on your phone. Skin photos never leave the device.

ai.title: How Nirapod's AI works
ai.intro: Each answer passes through these steps. Photos are checked on your phone, and every fact comes from verified data and fixed safety rules.
ai.diagram: Diagram: photo or text, then AI on the phone, then verified data and safety rules, then a language model that only rephrases verified facts, then your signal or explanation.

verified.title: Verified data + safety rules
verified.line2: fixed rules for medicines and sugar

result.title: Your signal or explanation
result.line1: green / amber / red, or plain words

models.food: Food model: YOLO11n-seg, recognises {classes, number} Bangladeshi foods.
models.accuracy: Mask mAP50 {map, number} on the PUST test split (prototype accuracy). Rice is still the hardest food, so the app always asks you to check the plate.
models.speed: Runs on the phone in about {seconds, number} seconds; photos are not uploaded.
models.medicines: Medicine database of {products, number} products, used for checks and cheaper same-medicine brands.
models.learning: Personal learning: after your 2-hour sugar readings, the meal signal adapts to you.
models.skin: Skin screening model: coming in the next phase.

ai.scaleTitle: Built for Bangladesh, designed to scale

scale.bangla: Bangla first: every screen in Bangla and English, Bangla by default.
scale.phones: Works on low-cost phones and without internet for on-device checks.
scale.retrain: The same design can be retrained with another country's foods, medicines and language: swap the model, the nutrition table, the medicine list and the language file.

safety.guide: Guides, never diagnoses: we say “may” and “possible”, and show how sure the AI is.
safety.medicine: Never changes your medicine: no advice to stop, start or change a medicine or insulin dose.
safety.photos: Photos stay on your phone: skin photos are never uploaded, and the top of a prescription (name, phone) is cut off before reading.
safety.emergency: Emergency help is always free and one tap away.

ai.llm: Handwritten prescriptions are read, and explanations reworded, by one language model on our server: Anthropic Claude or Google Gemini, whichever this copy of the app is set up with. Before sending, the top of the photo (name, phone, address) is cut off and you are asked first. Nothing is stored.
ai.llmNone: This copy has no AI service set up: medicines are typed with suggestions from the medicine list, or found on the phone from a printed prescription, and explanations use a fixed template.
ai.llmChecking: Checking which AI service is set up…

about.family: For children who live away from their parents: daily check-ins, reminders in their own voice, refill and emergency alerts. It is a preview and not live yet; sharing will be opt-in by the parent and end-to-end encrypted.

family.title: Family Plan
family.headline: Stay close to your parents' health, even from far away.
family.intro: Our main Premium idea, for children who live away from their parents. This page shows what we are building. Nothing on it works yet: no sharing, no sync and no payment.
family.featuresTitle: What the Family Plan will do

checkin.title: “I'm fine today” check-in
checkin.desc: The parent taps one big button each morning; the child sees a green tick, or a gentle alert if there is no check-in by a chosen time.

voice.title: Reminders in your own voice
voice.desc: The child records “Amma, time for your medicine”, and the reminder plays that voice.

remote.title: Remote setup and simple mode
remote.desc: The child sets up medicines and reminders from their own phone; parents get large buttons, large text and read-aloud.

refill.title: Medicine refill alerts
refill.desc: The app tracks how much medicine is left and alerts the child 5 days before it runs out, with pharmacy ordering paid from abroad.

emergency.title: Emergency alerts to family
emergency.desc: When the parent calls 999 or has low sugar, family members get an instant alert with location and nearby hospitals.

plate.title: Plate sharing with encouragement
plate.desc: The child sees the parent's meal signal and sends a one-tap note of encouragement.

visit.title: After-visit summary
visit.desc: When a new prescription is scanned, the child sees what changed (added or removed medicines), with no advice.

story.title: Monthly health story
story.desc: A simple monthly summary for the child (doses taken, green plates, low readings), with a short note from a nutritionist.

preview.label: Preview — sample, not live yet
preview.note: Sample data drawn for this preview. Nothing is sent, shared or saved.

checkin.done: Thank you, Amma. Rafi will see it.
checkin.abba: Abba: no check-in yet (chosen time 10:00 am)

refill.parent: Your medicine is running low. Rafi has been told.

visit.ask: Questions? Ask the doctor or pharmacist.
visit.parent: Prescription confirmed and saved. Rafi will see what changed.

story.nutritionistNote: More vegetables at dinner this month. Keep it up!
story.parent: Your month: 18 green plates. Rafi sends love.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Family sharing will be opt-in by the parent and end-to-end encrypted. Free users' data never leaves the phone. Skin photos are never shared.

price.line: Planned price: about BDT 99–149 per month

family.free: Skin screening, Medicine Safety and Emergency are free. In the Diabetes Companion, the plate signal, blood sugar entry and low-sugar help stay free after the trial.

homeCard.title: Family Plan
homeCard.desc: For children who live away from their parents — Family Plan, coming soon

family.moreDesc: Our main Premium idea: help your parents from far away. Not live yet.
